conceptZh: 雲是天上飄著的白色棉花團
object: a chunky toy fire engine with its crew and a fluffy cotton cloud
morph: a domino chain of foam pieces tumbles and lands as 雲
creativeAngle: 消防小隊撞倒第一塊骨牌，連鎖倒成字，水管噴出雲朵。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 雲 (cloud). Lead: a red toy fire engine with a bendy yellow hose that whips around on its own. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): the engine rolls in and gently bumps the first blue domino; the voice says 雲 as the domino wobbles. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): the chain tumbles across the stage, the hose squirting in the wrong direction and bending a few; the second 雲 lands as the last piece clicks, forming 雲. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the hose finally puffs a soft white fluffy cloud from the nozzle; as the voice says 雲朵 the cloud grows, floats up, and the firefighter pup toy rides it. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; the cloud drifts and drops a tiny harmless sparkle on the engine. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "雲、雲、雲朵" (ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ、ㄩㄣˊ ㄉㄨㄛˇ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 雲, drawn as saturated solid sky blue strokes on a very pale warm gray background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
